card.name: Punctuation before corticosteroid or NSAID names
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small linking words right before an expected drug name, mainly after corticosteroid or NSAID mentions, such as after "e.g.", "(" or "of".

modes.label: After e.g. or in lists
modes.description: A comma or period in an example list where the next word is a specific anti-inflammatory drug name.
modes.example: longer half-lives (e.g., meloxicam<<,>> nabumetone), patients taking these

modes.label: After corticosteroid mention
modes.description: An opening bracket or the word with/of after corticosteroid or premedication wording, before a steroid name or detail.
modes.example: All patients should be premedicated with oral corticosteroids<< (>>see below for prostate cancer) such as
